question: Is there a public legal information-seeking question source of sufficient size and representativeness to calibrate the prevalence of date-constrained questions?
description: The proxy-validation study needs a real legal information-seeking source large enough for a stable prevalence estimate. Public legal Q&A archives are asker-generated and may over-represent unusual or contested questions, published judgments are lawyer-generated and jurisdiction-bound, and no query log from a legal research platform is likely to be obtainable. If no adequate source exists, prevalence stays a swept assumption and no calibration is possible.
rationale: Without such a source the deployment-weighted estimate in plan E007 cannot be calibrated and only an explicitly assumed range can be reported.
